title: PM Modi Announces ₹85,000 Crore for Samudra Manthan

blocks.content: Samudra Manthan is the National Offshore Exploration Scheme under the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas. The Union Cabinet approved it on 31 July 2026 as a Central Sector Scheme up to FY 2030-31, and the Prime Minister announced an allocation of ₹85,000 crore on 15 August 2026 during the 80th Independence Day address at the Red Fort, New Delhi.

items: The Exclusive Economic Zone is a maritime zone recognised under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.
Seismic mapping is used to study subsurface geological structures before exploratory drilling begins.
Deepwater and ultra-deepwater drilling are used for offshore hydrocarbon exploration in marine basins.
Central Sector Schemes are funded and implemented by the Union Government.
